note: Conformance vectors for traigent.content_identity.v1 (docs/identity/content-identity-v1.md). Generated by scripts/generate_content_identity_v1_vectors.py from traigent_schema/example_identity.py; do not hand-edit. Tenant master secrets here are PUBLIC TEST VALUES. In 'examples', a field that is absent means ABSENT and a field set to null means null, which the spec normalizes to absent for context, expected and metadata. 'rejections' of kind json_text must be fed through the implementation's STRICT JSON text parser (JSON.parse alone keeps the last duplicate key and rounds big integers), then example_id must be computed from the parsed 'input'; every step may raise but none may yield an id.

examples.name: baseline
examples.description: Plain object input with expected output.

examples.name: key_order_permuted
examples.description: Same as baseline with input keys inserted in the other order; must equal baseline (jcs_v1 sorts keys).

examples.name: expected_changed
examples.description: Same input as baseline, different expected output: SAME example_id, DIFFERENT example_version.

examples.name: expected_absent
examples.description: Baseline input with no expected output.

examples.name: expected_null
examples.description: expected: null is the same as absent; must equal expected_absent.

examples.name: with_metadata
examples.description: Baseline plus version-relevant metadata: same id, different version.

examples.name: metadata_empty
examples.description: metadata: {} is the same as absent; must equal baseline.

examples.name: with_context
examples.description: Baseline plus retrieval context: context is part of the INPUT, so the example_id differs from baseline.

examples.name: context_null
examples.description: context: null is the same as absent; must equal baseline.

examples.name: context_empty_object
examples.description: context: {} is a value, NOT absent; must differ from baseline.

examples.name: string_input
examples.description: Bare string input (Backend input_text shape).

examples.name: list_input
examples.description: Multi-turn list input (Backend input_text list shape).

examples.name: unicode_nfc
examples.description: U+00E9 precomposed. No Unicode normalization: differs from unicode_nfd.

examples.name: unicode_nfd
examples.description: e + U+0301 combining acute. Must differ from unicode_nfc.

examples.name: non_bmp_keys
examples.description: Keys U+1F600 and U+FF21: UTF-16 code-unit order puts U+1F600 first.

examples.name: escapes_and_controls
examples.description: Quote, backslash, newline, tab and U+0001 inside a string.

examples.name: floats
examples.description: ECMAScript number formatting inside the safe range: 1e-7, 0.1, 1.5e15, 123.456, -0.0 -> 0.

examples.name: int_one
examples.description: Integer 1.

examples.name: float_one
examples.description: Float 1.0 canonicalizes like integer 1 (documented fp2 limit); must equal int_one.

examples.name: bool_true
examples.description: true is not 1; must differ from int_one.

examples.name: max_safe_integer
examples.description: 2**53-1 is the largest accepted integer.

examples.name: max_safe_float
examples.description: 9007199254740991.0 (float, = 2**53-1) is accepted and equals the integer; any number of larger magnitude, float or integer, is rejected.

examples.name: nesting_at_limit
examples.description: input nested 99 containers deep: with the payload wrapper that is the jcs_v1 limit of 100, so it is ACCEPTED (100 is rejected, see rejections).

examples.name: nested_empty_containers
examples.description: Empty object and array nested.

examples.name: cross_tenant
examples.description: Baseline under tenant_b: different kid and different ids.

examples.name: rotated_key
examples.description: Baseline under tenant_a's rotated master: different kid and ids.

examples.name: with_annotations
examples.description: Baseline carrying external_id, source_ref and supersedes: they are annotations and must NOT change example_id or example_version.

examples.name: reused_master_other_tenant
examples.description: Baseline under tenant_c, which reuses tenant_a's master by mistake: tenant_id in the HKDF info still gives a different kid and ids.

projections.name: reserved_keys_stripped
projections.description: Every reserved annotation key is dropped from metadata; context is lifted into the id payload.

projections.name: nulls_are_absent
projections.description: expected_output None and metadata.context None are absent; a metadata map left empty after stripping is absent.

multisets.name: order_b
multisets.description: Same five members reversed; must equal order_a.

multisets.name: with_duplicate
multisets.description: base listed twice plus one other: base counted 2.

multisets.name: explicit_count
multisets.description: base with explicit count 2 plus one other; must equal with_duplicate.

multisets.name: without_duplicate
multisets.description: base once plus one other; must DIFFER from with_duplicate (multiset, not set).

multisets.name: conflicting_versions
multisets.description: One example_id with two versions: root defined, conflict reported.

multisets.name: empty
multisets.description: Empty multiset: RFC 9162 MTH of no leaves = SHA-256 of the empty string; needs an explicit key_id.

rejections.name: duplicate_key
rejections.description: Duplicate object key in the input JSON text.

rejections.name: nan_literal
rejections.description: NaN literal.

rejections.name: infinity_literal
rejections.description: Infinity literal.

rejections.name: float_overflow
rejections.description: 1e400 overflows to Infinity.

rejections.name: integer_above_safe
rejections.description: 2**53 as an integer literal.

rejections.name: integer_below_safe
rejections.description: -(2**53) as an integer literal.

rejections.name: lone_surrogate
rejections.description: A lone high surrogate escape in a value.

rejections.name: lone_surrogate_key
rejections.description: A lone low surrogate escape in an object KEY.

rejections.name: integer_2_53_plus_1
rejections.description: 9007199254740993 (2**53+1) as an integer literal: JS JSON.parse would silently round it to 2**53.

rejections.name: float_literal_2_53_plus_1
rejections.description: 9007199254740993.0: a fractional-form literal outside the safe range is rejected like the integer form, so JS and Python cannot diverge.

rejections.name: float_literal_1e16
rejections.description: 1e16: exponent-form literal outside the safe range.

rejections.name: long_fraction_just_over_limit
rejections.description: 9007199254740991.0000000000001: exact value just above 2**53-1. A 28-digit Decimal context rounds it to the limit; the comparison must be exact.

rejections.name: float_literal_exact_value_above_safe
rejections.description: 9007199254740991.1: its EXACT decimal value is above 2**53-1 even though it rounds to 9007199254740991.0. Judge the literal, not the rounded double.

rejections.name: reserved_metadata_key
rejections.description: compute_example_version with a reserved annotation key in metadata (caller skipped the projection).

rejections.name: zero_count
rejections.description: A member count of 0.

rejections.name: mixed_key_ids
rejections.description: Members minted under two key ids.

rejections.name: short_tenant_master
rejections.description: A 31-byte tenant master secret.

rejections.name: tenant_id_with_colon
rejections.description: tenant_id outside ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}$.

rejections.name: tenant_id_empty
rejections.description: Empty tenant_id.

rejections.name: tenant_id_non_ascii
rejections.description: Non-ASCII tenant_id (U+00E9).

rejections.name: nesting_over_limit
rejections.description: input nested 100 containers deep: 101 with the payload wrapper, over the jcs_v1 limit of 100 (nesting_at_limit, 99, is accepted).

rejections.name: agent_build_dirty_without_source_digest
rejections.description: code_revision.dirty=true without source_digest: two different dirty trees on one commit would share a build_digest.

rejections.name: agent_build_partial_coverage_certifiable
rejections.description: coverage='partial' used where a certifiable manifest is required.

rejections.name: agent_build_missing_asset_category
rejections.description: asset_digests without tool_definitions: every category is required ({} asserts none).

rejections.name: agent_build_missing_config
rejections.description: No applied_config_digest: the configuration is part of the version.

rejections.name: agent_build_missing_runtime
rejections.description: No runtime: a build's runtime affects behaviour, so it is required.

rejections.name: agent_build_missing_coverage
rejections.description: No coverage declaration.

rejections.name: evaluator_objectives_unsorted
rejections.description: Objectives not sorted by name: one set must have one spelling.

rejections.name: evaluator_config_digest_omitted
rejections.description: config_digest omitted (efp2 covers source only).

rejections.name: evaluator_helper_digests_omitted
rejections.description: helper_digests omitted ({} is how to say 'none').

rejections.name: evaluator_judge_omitted
rejections.description: judge key omitted (must be explicit null for a model-free evaluator).

rejections.name: tenant_id_trailing_newline
rejections.description: tenant_id with a trailing newline: patterns are FULL-string matches.

rejections.name: example_id_trailing_newline
rejections.description: example_version for an example_id with a trailing newline.

rejections.name: member_trailing_newline
rejections.description: A multiset member whose example_version has a trailing newline.

rejections.name: total_count_overflow
rejections.description: Two members whose counts sum past 2**53-1 (each count alone is valid).

rejections.name: in_memory_1e16
rejections.description: In-memory float 1e16 (no JSON text involved).

rejections.name: agent_build_without_revision_or_source
rejections.description: Neither code_revision nor source_digest: identifies nothing.

json_text_accepted.name: long_fraction_just_under_limit
json_text_accepted.description: 9007199254740990.9999999999999999999: exact value just BELOW 2**53-1, so accepted; it rounds to the double 9007199254740991.0.

json_text_accepted.name: limit_with_trailing_zeros
json_text_accepted.description: 9007199254740991.0000000000000: exact value EQUAL to 2**53-1, so accepted.

agent_builds.name: full_reordered
agent_builds.description: Same manifest, keys in reverse order; must equal full.

agent_builds.name: config_changed
agent_builds.description: Same build, different candidate configuration: a different version.

agent_builds.name: helper_changed
agent_builds.description: Only a helper module changed: a different version.

agent_builds.name: prompt_changed
agent_builds.description: Only a prompt changed: a different version.

agent_builds.name: tool_changed
agent_builds.description: Only a tool definition changed: a different version.

agent_builds.name: partial_coverage
agent_builds.description: coverage='partial' still yields a build_digest (history), but is rejected for certifiable use (see rejections).

agent_builds.name: relabelled
agent_builds.description: Same bits, different label: a different version by design.

evaluator_versions.name: base
evaluator_versions.description: A judge-backed evaluator with two objectives.

evaluator_versions.name: base_reordered_keys
evaluator_versions.description: Same manifest, keys in reverse order; must equal base.

evaluator_versions.name: orientation_changed
evaluator_versions.description: cost orientation flipped to maximize: a different version.

evaluator_versions.name: judge_model_changed
evaluator_versions.description: Judge model changed: a different version.

evaluator_versions.name: judge_config_changed
evaluator_versions.description: Judge configuration changed: a different version.

evaluator_versions.name: model_free
evaluator_versions.description: judge: null for a model-free evaluator (explicit, never omitted).

evaluator_versions.name: model_free_threshold_changed
evaluator_versions.description: Model-free evaluator: only its bound configuration (e.g. a pass threshold) changed -- efp2 would not see this; config_digest does.

evaluator_versions.name: model_free_helper_changed
evaluator_versions.description: Model-free evaluator: only a local helper file changed.

evaluator_versions.name: no_helpers
evaluator_versions.description: helper_digests {} asserts the evaluator has no local helpers.
